svg.text: v0.4 · DRAFT · one DRV8871 driver per ship · net labels (+12V, +5V, GND, D-pins) join wherever they appear
VIN to GND, at the pin
C8 47 µF + C10 100 nF, VM to GND at the board
C9 47 µF + C11 100 nF, VM to GND at the board
NC switches: closed = away from limit (LOW),
open at limit (HIGH). Broken wire = "at limit".
1. Drivers U2/U3 plug into female headers. Inputs have 100 kΩ internal pull-downs: Nano reset or power loss = inputs low = coast (motor unpowered).
2. Firmware stop = brake (IN1 = IN2 = HIGH). Forward/reverse = one input PWM, the other LOW. Which input drives toward POS1 is set on the bench.
3. Driver current limit ≈ 2.1 A (Adafruit 30 kΩ R_ILIM). F1 protects the 12V wiring upstream of the drivers.
4. No TVS diodes or capacitors at the motors: not needed with the driver, and a cap across a PWM-driven motor causes current spikes.
5. Limit switches are NC (bench-verified 2026-10-19). Pull-up and RC filter sit at the Nano end.
6. Every GND symbol is one common ground. Dashed lines = field cable.
